# Allure Wellness & Esthetics

> Boutique medical spa and wellness clinic in Plantation, Florida (Broward County), founded by Vanessa Gonzalez and Alicia Jimenez, APRN. Medical weight loss, IV therapy, HydraFacials, Venus Bliss MAX body contouring, nutrition coaching and functional lab testing. English and Spanish spoken.

## Key facts
- Address: 8320 W Sunrise Blvd, Suite 211, Plantation, FL 33322
- Phone: 954-228-5034
- Online booking: https://allure-wellness-and-esthetics.square.site/
- Google rating: 5.0 from 26 reviews (November 2026)
- Team: Alicia Jimenez, board-certified APRN (medical evaluation and prescribing); Vanessa Gonzalez, co-founder and National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach (nutrition); Laritza Corrales, licensed esthetician (facials, Venus Bliss MAX).
- Serves: Plantation, Fort Lauderdale, Sunrise, Davie, Lauderhill, Weston, Tamarac and Broward County.
- IV prices: Mini IV from $85 (about 30 minutes); Campus Recharge IV $67 for Broward College and NSU students with ID.
- Medical weight loss: semaglutide or tirzepatide when appropriate, after consultation and labs; monthly check-ins, InBody scans and nutrition coaching included; 3-month minimum.

## Treatments
- [Medical weight loss](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/medical-weight-loss): Allure offers provider-supervised medical weight loss in Plantation, FL. A board-certified nurse practitioner reviews your history and labs, prescribes semaglutide or tirzepatide if it's safe for you, and checks in monthly. Nutrition coaching and InBody body-composition scans are included. Programs run a 3-month minimum.
- [IV therapy & wellness injections](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/iv-therapy-wellness-injections): Allure's IV menu in Plantation, FL includes Mini IVs from $85 (about 30 minutes), Brain Fuel, Immunity and Essential Glow drips, iron infusions after lab work, and B12 and glutathione shots. Broward College and NSU students get the Campus Recharge IV for $67 with a student ID. Every drip starts with a health screening.
- [HydraFacials & skin treatments](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/hydrafacials-skin-treatments): Allure performs HydraFacials in Plantation, FL. A session takes about 30 minutes (45 with a booster), has no downtime, and is best repeated every 3 to 4 weeks. A licensed esthetician tailors the serums to your skin, including sensitive skin.
- [Body contouring · Venus Bliss MAX](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/body-contouring-venus-bliss-max): Venus Bliss MAX at Allure in Plantation, FL combines diode laser fat reduction, radiofrequency skin tightening and muscle stimulation. Sessions take 30 to 45 minutes with no downtime. Most plans are 4 to 8 weekly sessions, and results develop over 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Nutrition & supplement programs](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/custom-supplements-nutrition-programs): Allure offers one-on-one nutrition coaching in Plantation, FL with Vanessa Gonzalez, a National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach. Plans cover eating, sleep and supplements, can be built from your lab results, and work on their own or alongside medical weight loss. No referral is needed.
- [Functional lab testing](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/functional-lab-testing): Allure offers functional lab testing and InBody body-composition scans in Plantation, FL. Five panels cover hormones, metabolism and thyroid, vitamins and minerals, peptides, and gut health. Results are reviewed with you and turned into a nutrition, supplement or medical plan. Testing is self-pay.

## Guides
- [Venus Bliss MAX vs. CoolSculpting: which is right for you?](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/blog/venus-bliss-max-vs-coolsculpting-plantation): Both reduce stubborn fat without surgery. CoolSculpting freezes fat cells; Venus Bliss MAX heats them, and also tightens skin and works the muscle. If loose skin or muscle tone matters to you, Venus Bliss MAX covers more in one session.
- [Semaglutide vs. tirzepatide: how we choose](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/blog/semaglutide-vs-tirzepatide): Both are weekly injections that reduce appetite. Semaglutide acts on one gut hormone receptor (GLP-1); tirzepatide acts on two (GLP-1 and GIP). In studies, tirzepatide produced more weight loss on average, but the right choice depends on your history, side effects and budget.
- [Functional lab testing vs. your yearly physical](https://www.allurewellnessesthetics.com/blog/functional-labs-vs-yearly-physical): A yearly physical usually checks a short list of markers to rule out disease. A functional panel adds markers like fasting insulin, vitamin D, ferritin, full thyroid and inflammation, and reads results against optimal ranges, not just normal ones.
